device: PINNED scroll section: scroll steps through ~6 places one at a time; per step a giant editorial minute number counts up 0->N while a single terracotta arc draws home->place on a quiet faded map. The map is the backdrop; TIME is the hero.
data_pipeline: SAME real-OSM bake as the smarts location map (Overpass -> projector -> viewBox px); home + POI coords + real walk/drive minutes. Drawn light + simplified.

fidelity.poi_labels: DOM nodes positioned via svg.getScreenCTM() -> render OUTSIDE the slice-clipped box, NEVER cropped (skeptic CRITICAL: baked-in <text> got clipped off-screen on the last step)
fidelity.poi_coords: kept in a SAFE CENTRAL BAND (x 300..700, y 250..610 of a 1000x800 viewBox) so the arc endpoint stays on the map at any stage aspect

counter_arc_sync: scrub progress*N -> step i + local 0..1; number = round(local*min); arc strokeDashoffset = len*(1-local), with local/0.8 so the value settles before the next step

responsive.mobile: <940px: gsap.matchMedia -> static (no pin), a calm map backdrop + the giant number + a FULL list of every place + minutes
responsive.reduced_motion: same static full-list state; lead copy swapped off 'Прокрутіть'

rail: one button per step (>=24px hit area via background-clip:content-box); click jumps to the step's SETTLED point ((i+0.78)/N) so the number matches the clicked label; keyboard + aria

palette.label_idle: #453f37 (idle POI labels, drawn at opacity 0.78 -> ~4.96 on the cream label chip, >= AA)

type.serif: Fraunces (giant number 300, italic place name, list minutes)

a11y.contrast: >=AA on cream (idle POI labels carry the other places' names, so they hold >= AA at opacity 0.78 with label_idle ink; active label = accent_ink, bold, opacity 1)
a11y.static_content: every place + minutes readable without motion
